digest.component_or_area: Jira DC image capability mapping tool and harness integration
propositions: The CI mapping job must be manually dispatched only, never triggered by push/PR/schedule, and this constraint must be tested not merely configured to prevent silent re-introduction of runtime discovery at test time.

A stale capability map after image re-pin is detectable by pinning the artifact's reported digest by construction from the Dockerfile FROM line and asserting it matches, preventing mislabeled provenance.
The job must capture raw REST request/response evidence behind each finding, keyed by evidence id, so answers remain traceable to data rather than to LLM summaries.

Four hardcoded vocabularies (issue types, statuses+transitions, priorities, link types) and five character limits must be validated live against the mapped instance and recorded as committed contract data consumed by harness setup assertions.

Link type direction cannot be validated by presence checks alone because Jira names and directions are distinct, requiring end-to-end round-trip testing that writes a link and reads it back from both sides to catch inversions.

Character limits require accept-and-truncate detection via read-back comparison rather than inference from successful writes, and DC's comment limit must be read from instance property jira.text.field.character.limit not assumed as 32767.
